title: sambucus racemosa subsp. pendula
intro: Sambucus racemosa subsp. pendula, commonly known as the American Red-berried Elder, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of the common cold, flu, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus racemosa subsp. pendula include immune system stimulation, antitussive, and anti-exudative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
